description: This file defines an abstract class for representing browser devices within the Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent component. It includes methods for feature detection, serialization, and user agent parsing.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice
classes.description: An abstract class for defining browser or device characteristics and features within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object state into a string.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Restores object state from a serialized string.

methods.name: _restoreFromArray
methods.description: Restores object properties from an array.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Loads and merges device features via a features adapter.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the device type identifier.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Checks if a feature is present.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific feature.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets a feature value and optionally assigns it to a group.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Associates a feature with a group.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieves features associated with a group.

methods.name: _getDefaultFeatures
methods.description: Extracts default features from user agent and server variables.

methods.name: extractFromUserAgent
methods.description: Parses a user agent string into components and features.

methods.name: _loadFeaturesAdapter
methods.description: Loads a features adapter class based on configuration.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Indicates if device has a phone number.

methods.name: _matchAgentAgainstSignatures
methods.description: Checks if user agent matches any signature in a list.
